whatIs.label: Is This Page For You?
whatIs.title: Your Product Is Unique. Your Store Should Be Too.
whatIs.paragraph1: Selling handmade jewelry? Designing your own clothing? Offering organic food? Just like your product, your store should be one of a kind.
whatIs.paragraph2: Generic templates can't carry your brand's soul. You don't want to blend in with thousands of others — you want to create an experience worth remembering.
whatIs.paragraph3: At Sybor Digital, we bring boutique brands to life in the digital world, building unique shopping experiences that reflect the true value of what you sell.

whatWeDo.label: What We Do
whatWeDo.title: Custom Digital Experiences for Boutique Brands

whatWeDo.paragraph3: After launch, we also support you with social media integrations, campaign management and customer segmentation.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions on your mind.

delivery.question: How long does a boutique store take?
delivery.answer: Typically 3-6 weeks depending on scope and product count. Priority processing is available for seasonal urgencies.

pricing.question: How is pricing determined?
pricing.answer: Based on product count, customization level and integration requirements. Clear proposal after a free call.

revisions.question: How many revisions do I get?
revisions.answer: Unlimited revisions during the design phase. In-scope development changes are included at no extra cost.

maintenance.question: Do I need technical help to add products?
maintenance.answer: No. We deliver an easy-to-use management panel. Training is included.

migration.question: Can I migrate from another platform?
migration.answer: Yes. We can migrate all your product and customer data from Etsy, Instagram Shop or other platforms.

mobile.question: Can Instagram Shop integration be set up?
mobile.answer: Yes. We connect Instagram Shop and TikTok Shop to turn your social media into a direct sales channel.
